filesystem_time_context.role: Context only. Save/copy/processing timestamps do not establish acquisition duration, packet independence or origin.

limitations: 20-frame fixed-grid windows plus winnowing of 20-frame rolling hashes in a 64-window span. Long exact overlaps of at least 83 frames are candidates regardless of offset; shorter unaligned overlaps can be missed.
Windows require at least five nonempty frames and five unique direction states; blank/constant segments are analysed separately as runs.
SHA-256 fingerprints compare direction sequences, not audio waveforms. Equal directions do not prove equal recorded sounds or a dishonest origin.
Paired AI/control simulations intentionally share their input. Such overlap is reported separately and never removed.

memory_build_evidence.interpretation: One existing build log/map only; these totals cannot populate both AI/control columns or validate paper numbers without build/configuration linkage

metric_protocol.matching: One-to-one maximum TP then minimum total circular error
metric_protocol.matched_mae_deg: sum circular error of TP pairs / TP; conditioned on <=15 degrees
metric_protocol.reference_activity_assumption: All declared reference sources active in every frame; CSV does not contain voice-activity ground truth
metric_protocol.aggregation: Micro pooling of TP/FP/FN within each N/mode/distance; not arithmetic averaging of per-file percentages

resampling_note: Existing moving-block per-file and geometry-cluster 95% bootstrap CIs reused after identical SHA-256. Conditional on clusters/stationarity, not independent frame trials or hardware validation.

known_selection_bias.interpretation: Outcome-based historical selection may inflate surviving performance; no causal or hardware authenticity conclusion.
known_selection_bias.origin_limitation: Historical MEASURED labels include unregistered native defaults; they are not independent acquisition verification.
known_selection_bias.action_this_audit: No historical file restored into or deleted from active folders; preserve existing archived versions separately
